text: Davidson's anomalous monism is best characterized as which combination of claims?
choices: Mental and physical are distinct substances that causally interact
Mental states will eventually be eliminated in favour of neural states
Mental types are strictly identical to physical types via bridge laws
Every mental event is token-identical to some physical event, yet there are no strict psychophysical laws
explanation: Anomalous monism is 'monism' (each mental event token is identical to some physical event) plus 'anomalism' (no strict laws connect mental and physical descriptions). Option 2 is the reductive type-identity view with bridge laws that Davidson denies; option 0 is Cartesian interactionism; option 1 is eliminativism. The distinctive move is token identity without type reduction.
